sample.about: Outside research E (Brandon Oct 31 7:49 PM): US parks with no camping info (5,643). Camping? YES / NO / NEARBY ONLY + campground names, the agency camping / reservation page, type, an official campground layer, notes ('Source type: …'). For the camp bot as sources (it opens every link itself) -> waiting room -> chat 11. 'layers' = official campground point layers + how many parks each covers.

US-1637.Name: Chugach State Park
US-1637.Campground name(s): Bird Creek; Bird Creek Overflow; Eagle River; Eklutna Lake campgrounds; public-use cabins
US-1637.Notes: Source type: AGENCY LIST PAGE. DPOR campground list: Bird Creek 27, Overflow 20, Eagle River 57, Eklutna 58 sites; park page lists public-use cabins.

US-4447.Name: Chugach National Forest
US-4447.Campground name(s): Barber Cabin; Crescent Lake Cabin; Caribou Creek Cabin; Crescent Saddle Cabin; Romig Cabin; Swan Lake Cabin; Dale Clemens Cabin; Devil's Pass Cabin; Upper Paradise Cabin; West Swan Lake Cabin; +42 more
US-4447.Notes: Source type: MAP LAYER. 52 USFS camping sites (Chugach National Forest) in USFS Recreation Opportunities layer; reservable sites are on Recreation.gov.

US-7211.Name: Finger Lake State Recreation Site
US-7211.Notes: Source type: AGENCY LIST PAGE. DPOR campground list: Finger Lake SRS *, 24 sites, fee $25-$35, reservable. Third-party managed.

US-0022.Name: Denali National Park
US-0022.Campground name(s): Riley Creek; Savage River; Sanctuary River; Teklanika River; Igloo Creek; Wonder Lake
US-0022.Notes: Source type: PARK PAGE. 6 NPS campground(s) per NPS campground data (nps.gov API).
